project.title: Legacy journal hash compatibility
project.goal: Verify exact existing canonical journal hashes on private snapshots before writable Rust work.
project.scope: Bounded R03/R09/R10/R11 refinement; not full audit integrity, writes, hosted authority or epic completion.

component.application.description: Own explicit local hash-check input/result contract.

boundary.responsibility: Own explicit local hash-check input/result contract.
boundary.rationale: Use cases have one explicit public boundary.

component.domain.description: Own exact amounts, dates and pure report aggregation.

boundary.responsibility: Own exact amounts, dates and pure report aggregation.
boundary.rationale: Keep accounting arithmetic separate from transport/storage.

component.storage.description: Own no-follow source capture and bounded current-schema read validation.

boundary.responsibility: Own source capture, current-schema decoding and legacy persistent hash byte compatibility.
boundary.rationale: SQLite sidecars require isolated recovery without touching source.
excludes: Accounting write authority, migrations and hosted access control

scenario.normal.description: All hashes and predecessor links match, count is exact and source bytes unchanged.

scenario.given: A real synthetic legacy-posted and reversed chain with fixed known canonical byte/hash vectors.
scenario.then: All hashes and predecessor links match, count is exact and source bytes unchanged.

scenario.boundary.description: Supported bytes match fixed vectors; unsupported storage/precision refuses, never silently normalizes invalid values to zero.

scenario.given: Unicode/controls/NUL, null/empty, FX exponents, huge/tie/rounding-tail values and unsafe or nonfinite input.
scenario.then: Supported bytes match fixed vectors; unsupported storage/precision refuses, never silently normalizes invalid values to zero.

scenario.isolation.description: No cross-root escape, implicit company creation or source mutation; refuse unsupported path.

scenario.given: A second company and symlink/nonregular/missing data or source file.
scenario.when: Attempt read through each selected local root.
scenario.then: No cross-root escape, implicit company creation or source mutation; refuse unsupported path.

scenario.schema.description: Typed fail-closed refusal; no migration, table repair or original-file modification.

scenario.given: A pending/newer/gapped/changed history, corrupt SQLite or FK/column/type drift.
scenario.then: Typed fail-closed refusal; no migration, table repair or original-file modification.

scenario.concurrent.description: A consistent validated private copy or source_changed refusal; committed WAL data is not silently omitted; source handles never write.

scenario.given: Committed WAL frames and a writer changing the source capture.
scenario.when: Take bounded stable snapshots while the source changes.
scenario.then: A consistent validated private copy or source_changed refusal; committed WAL data is not silently omitted; source handles never write.

scenario.atomic.description: All temp files cleaned; no partial success report and no source side effects.

scenario.given: Private snapshot recovery/query fails or source changes before stable capture.
scenario.then: All temp files cleaned; no partial success report and no source side effects.

scenario.usage.description: One JSON invalid_input, exit 2, no source open.

scenario.given: Missing, duplicate, unknown or empty company flags.
scenario.then: One JSON invalid_input, exit 2, no source open.

scenario.repeat.description: Same scoped result and no durable effects.

scenario.then: Same scoped result and no durable effects.

rule.source_immutable.description: Never open original DB/sidecars writable, migrate or repair them.

rule.statement: Every source byte is unchanged by successful or refused reads; only a private temporary copy may recover.

scenario.unstable.description: Return source_changed, remove any private files and leave source bytes untouched by the reader.

scenario.given: Every one of four source captures changes its DB or sidecar state.
scenario.then: Return source_changed, remove any private files and leave source bytes untouched by the reader.

action.verify_journal_hashes.description: Verify existing canonical journal hashes without touching source ledgers.

errors.invalid_input: Reject missing, duplicate or unknown flags before source access.
errors.source_unavailable: Reject missing, symlink, nonregular or inaccessible source; no writes.
errors.source_changed: Reject after four unstable captures; no source mutation.
errors.unsupported_schema: Reject noncurrent/history/physical report-contract mismatch without migration.
errors.invalid_ledger: Reject invalid types/UTF-8/numeric precision/nonfinite conversion without partial success.
errors.storage_failure: Reject failed private recovery/I/O; cleanup temp files; no source writes.

preconditions: Input is canonical and local OS file authority permits read; no hosted membership claim.
postconditions: Source DB and sidecar bytes are unchanged; private temporary state is cleaned.
Exact canonical JSON bytes and SHA-256 preserve legacy stored hash continuity; mismatch is never success.
Result is explicitly journal-hash-only, not full accounting/audit integrity.
external_effects: Read source file descriptors and create/recover/query/delete a private temporary SQLite copy; never write source or perform network I/O.

authorization.rationale: Local file boundary, no implicit company/root escape.

idempotency.rationale: Repeatable read only; no durable write receipt or external delivery.

boundaries.rationale: Dates, monetary rounding/types, schema and input limits.

concurrency.rationale: Capture may race a writer or WAL changes.

atomicity.rationale: Private-copy failure must never mutate source or report partial success.

action.verify_journal_hashes.behavior: Capture and validate private current-schema snapshot; read ordered persisted entry/line data; construct fixed-order legacy JSON with JS number normalization; compare predecessor/hash and no-lines; return explicitly scoped diagnostics, never mutate source.

scenario.hash_mismatch.description: Return scoped ok:false diagnostics, exit 1, and unchanged source; never claim full audit integrity.

scenario.given: A chain with modified text/actor/FX/line order/hash/predecessor or missing journal lines.
scenario.then: Return scoped ok:false diagnostics, exit 1, and unchanged source; never claim full audit integrity.
